claims.statement: One brief for each message with lettered options and an honest recommendation, the open and paused states kept on offer, the check of the operator's own alternatives against the code, the merge, split, reorder and resolve effects, and the owners' list are conventions of this workflow. Decision files follow the shared template and write rules of recording-handoff.
